notes: A227784.A227781_conjecture: 0 < n -> (a n = 4 <-> 8 | n) and (a n = 3 <-> n % 8 = 4), a n = sInf {k | -1 is a sum of k squares in ZMod n}; also a n <= 2 when 4 does not divide n. Route: CRT, two squares mod odd p + Hensel, Lagrange for 8 | n, residues mod 4 and 8. Outside Lean: none (agreement with the b-file checked by certificate/check.py for n <= 600).
